address: Urstein Nord 24, Puch bei Hallein, 5412, Austria
bio: The name says it all: all the ingredients used here are certified organic. You can compile your own three- to five-course set menu from a list of ambitious modern options, or simply order à la carte. Some dishes such as the mountain hay soup with veal sweetbreads, ash and bee pollen highlight their connection to the region; others such as the X.O. mature beef with sweet potato, spicy cucumber and mole showcase international influences – in this case, inspired by chef Erhard Schober's travels in Mexico. There are also vegetarian alternatives. A range of exciting original cocktails is available to complement your meal.
